_note: Relevance rules. A source lists the groups an item must contain (`needs`). A term matches at the start of a word, so 'foreclos' matches foreclosure and foreclosed. Each needed group scores 2 if it is in the title and 1 if only in the snippet, plus the source weight. An item needs at least `threshold` to become a candidate. Risk flags do not change the score: they tell the person or model doing the drafting which voice-guide rules apply (docs/voice.md).

riskNotes.names-party: A party may be named. Write about the pattern, not the party, unless it is public record, counsel has cleared it, and it is attributed.
riskNotes.failure: A bank failure. Do not ride it for attention; write only about mechanics, later.
riskNotes.layoffs-closure: A closure or layoffs. Do not ride it for attention.
riskNotes.ruling: A ruling. Give the court, the date, whether it is published, whether it is state-specific, and whether it was withdrawn or appealed. Say what it does not decide.
riskNotes.figures: Has figures. State the measure, the publisher, and the date for each, and open the source to confirm.
